modules.module_title: Receive the jewellery from the concerned person

pcs.pc_description: Coordinate with the concerned department to collect the jewel.
Identify the procedures of jewel making and the raw materials used.
Receive the record sheet along with the jewel to note the defects during the specific process.

modules.module_title: Understand job sheet, design and the customer requirement

pcs.pc_description: Receive instructions on the required work from superior.
Receive the design and the job sheet from concerned person.
Interpret the job sheet and the design requirement keeping in mind the different quality parameters of the jewellery and raw materials used to make the same.
Plan the target number of pieces to be checked.

Identify design and specific process related defects with respect to design defects such as mismatch of design, product processing defects such as - rough edges and surfaces, polishing standards, colouring, shaping, and finishing defects such as - alignment, secure stone setting, etc.
Report to the concerned department and return the jewellery, in case rework is required.
Ensure no functional and specific checks are skipped, for the respective raw material- based jewel.
Ensure to take any safety precautions before checking on any jewel.
Pass on the defective jewel to the concerned departments clearly labelling / marking the errors so identified.
Collect the jewel from the respective departments once the identified defects are rectified.
Check if all the highlighted errors are rectified and the jewel is defect free.
Upon ensuring that the finished jewel meets the customer requirements, label the jewels.
Deliver the checked jewellery to the concerned department on time.

modules.module_title: Check if the jewellery matches the market requirement

pcs.pc_description: Ensure the local market requirements are satisfied based on the client location and customer requirement.
Ensure to incorporate the international design and fashion trends according to the different market segments.
Ensure the raw materials used are in accordance with the law of the country to which the jewel is exported.
Record the results of the quality check.
Identify the recurring defects or errors and document the same.
Suggest improvements in the process to avoid the recurring defects.
Record the number of products checked every day.
Report on any anticipated delays that may affect delivery.
Escalate any unresolved problems to the supervisor.
Report on the recurring defects if any, found during the quality check, to the supervisor.

modules.module_title: Packaging and Labelling of Fashion Jewellery

pcs.pc_description: Packaging should be visually attractive ana align with brand identity.
Packaging should include compartments or support to prevent movement during transit.
Labels must include essential details.
Achieve the targeted number of jewels to be quality checked.
Ensure defect free products are sent for packing.
Use only recommended tools for checking every jewel product.
